title: Git commit SHA
summary: A Git commit SHA is a 40-character hexadecimal string (SHA-1) or 64-character string (SHA-256) that uniquely identifies a commit. The SHA is computed over the commit object (tree, parents, author, committer, message).

notes: The SHA is computed over: 'commit {size}\0{content}' where content is tree + parents + author + committer + message.
Short SHAs (7+ chars) are often used for display.
Git objects (blob, tree, commit, tag) are all content-addressed by SHA.
